name: isolation-analysis-test-71231d7fc4/semantic-negative-e.bal
spec_references: ## Expressions: lists 'New expression' and 'Anonymous function expression', but does not list object constructor expressions.
reason: The case asserts rejection of non-isolated object methods, function values, and bound methods assigned to isolated types. Its first assertion essentially uses an anonymous object constructor (`object { ... }`) to produce the source object. Object constructor expressions are absent from the supported expression list, so the whole case requires an unsupported construct despite explicit support for isolated functions and classes.
unsupported_constructs: Anonymous object constructor expression initializing obj
test_design_notes: Negative isolation/type-compatibility assertions are in scope when expressed using supported constructs; illegality alone is not the reason for this classification.
